sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Page setup and calculations
sections.what: Loads the store data, label text for the owner's style, and modal state. It works out the CGPA, the goal text, and a daily count of completed study and coding habits.
sections.why: Prepares every number the page shows before drawing it.
sections.watch_out: The habit count assumes every habit has a completion history.

sections.name: SemesterDashboardView (part 1)
sections.title: Header and CGPA stat tiles
sections.what: Shows the page title, subtitle, graded course count, and three tiles for CGPA, target goal and credits. The target goal tile opens the goal pop-up when clicked.
sections.why: Gives the owner the headline academic numbers at once.

sections.name: SemesterDashboardView (part 2)
sections.title: Course cards
sections.what: Lists each course as a card showing code, grade, name, professor, credits and attendance, with an edit button on each. Shows a prompt to add the first course when none exist.
sections.why: Lets the owner review and edit every course.

sections.name: SemesterDashboardView (part 3)
sections.title: Pending assignments list
sections.what: Lists every assignment with pending status, showing title, weight, due date and priority. Shows a message when none are pending.
sections.why: Keeps unfinished work visible on the academic page.
sections.watch_out: The list does not filter by date, so overdue or far-off items appear equally.

sections.name: SemesterDashboardView (part 4)
sections.title: Heatmap and pop-ups
sections.what: Shows the study activity heatmap and places the course and goal pop-ups on the page, each opened or closed by page state.
sections.why: Gives the owner a yearly view of study effort, and keeps the pop-ups available to the page.

summary: The main academic page that shows the owner's CGPA, target goal, course cards, pending assignments and a study activity heatmap.
purpose: Gives the owner one place to see academic progress and manage courses and the CGPA goal.
why: Brings the course, assignment and study data together so progress is visible at a glance.
how: It reads courses, assignments, habits and the profile from the store. It calculates the CGPA and totals, counts pending and graded assignments, and builds a daily study count from study and coding habits. It renders the header, stat tiles, course cards, pending assignment list, heatmap, and the course and goal pop-ups.
inputs: Data from the store: profile, courses, assignments and habits. The owner's clicks on add, edit and goal buttons.
outputs: A page of cards and tiles on screen. Opening the course and goal pop-ups. No data is changed directly on this page.
risks: The pending list shows every pending assignment, not only those due soon, despite the label saying due. A habit without a completion history could break the heatmap calculation. Counts depend on the status values being exactly right.
debug: If the CGPA looks wrong, check the calculation helper and the grades on each course. If the heatmap is empty, check that study or coding habits have completed entries. If the goal shows dashes, no goal has been saved.
